01 / A COMPLEMENTARY STARTING PORTFOLIO

Different questions. Useful next experiments.

Operational readiness is concentrated in equivalence, intervention protocols and representation repair. ALife adds nonlinear memory and history. Hardware realization and semantic geometry require larger untested assumptions.

03 / QUALITY WITHOUT A TOTAL SCORE

Compare the profiles.

Read the scoring rubric and sensitivity limits

Each judgment has a bounded ±1 sensitivity band. These are not confidence intervals. The dimensions answer different questions; statistical orthogonality has not been established. Novelty potential and evidence are kept separate.

The experiment queue requires specification ≥3, discrimination ≥3 and tractability ≥2. Pareto labels compare eligible ideas within the same niche, preserve ties and use nominal scores. No robust dominance survives the declared ±1 bands. This is a planning screen, not a scientific-validation gate.

04 / EXECUTED CONTROLS

Five illustrations. One failed metric.

New calculations under explicit dimensionless protocols. The source’s linked notebook was not recovered; these are independently specified illustrations, not a reproduction of its reported five demos or 39 checks.

Transformation count is not information preservation.

All 256 elementary cellular automaton rules were enumerated on a six-site periodic ring, with two input bits, four initial environment bits and three update steps. The environment then evolves. Output entropy uses uniform inputs at fixed environment; it is not a general computational-capacity measure.
